_about: The Locked Folder's shared interface (UI contract 1.2), a protected document: before any page the client asks media.vault's status, shows its own unlock prompt while the vault is locked and the setup page while it can't be opened yet, keeps the unlock alive while shown and locks on leaving (docs/ui-contract.md, "Protected documents"). Photo opens it from its Albums through the section action; it is a preview, so both clients keep opening the Locked Folder's own screens there and offer this document in Developer Mode until it is validated (docs/satellites/locked_folder.md, "Shared interface"). It reads the read-only views (views.py: gallery, setup) and changes the vault only through its existing routes: upload, delete, move_out and media/file for a download. Nothing is shared, kept offline or shown as a widget. Settings, the PIN, biometrics, encryption and recovery stay in its own screens until L4.
